why: Locks one of the two deterministic false positives already measured: the rule was blind to a test named in Portuguese — 43 tracked files with `prova` in the name in the alicerce and the rule saw ZERO, in a checker written in Portuguese. This variant isolates the PATH SEGMENT branch: the only test file on the pass side is `provas/soma.mjs`, and no file name would match on its own. If the `provas` segment leaves the recognizer, the pass side exits 1. The Portuguese folder name stays: it is PASTA_TESTE vocabulary, what the recognizer searches for inside third-party repositories.
